BoatraceCSV/boatracecsv.github.io.body:
# Boatrace Data Automation

Boatrace data is spread across proprietary formats, and collecting and formatting it takes time. To make it easier to use for machine learning, we created CSV files with one race per row.
Since they can be downloaded over HTTPS, they are also easy for Agents to access.
They are updated once a day (real-time series every 5 minutes).
If you need the latest information, please use another source such as [Boatrace OpenAPI](https://github.com/BoatraceOpenAPI).

## Data Download

All files can be downloaded from the root `https://boatracecsv.github.io/` using the following paths.

- `data/programs/title/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — per-race race name
- `data/programs/race_cards/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — detailed racecard (出走表)
- `data/programs/recent_national/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — nationwide recent form over the last 5 meets (全国近況5節)
- `data/programs/recent_local/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — local-venue recent form over the last 5 meets (当地近況5節)
- `data/programs/motor_stats/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — motor period performance (モーター期成績)
- `data/previews/{tkz,stt,sui,original_exhibition}/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — pre-race information (直前情報)
- `data/results/realtime/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — semi-real-time results 5 to 30 minutes after close
- `data/results/payouts/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — payouts 5 to 30 minutes after close
- `data/estimate/index/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — strength points (5-factor deviation values + contribution + total)

All files can be joined using the race code `レースコード` (12 digits, `YYYYMMDDjjrr`) as the common key.

## Documentation

For detailed documentation, see [`docs/`](https://github.com/BoatraceCSV/boatracecsv.github.io/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md).

- [Data specification](https://github.com/BoatraceCSV/boatracecsv.github.io/blob/HEAD/docs/data/README.md) — schema, column definitions, and relationship diagrams for each CSV

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

Nianjiujiang/pdx-map-editor.body:
# Paradox Cartography

> **Current version: v1.11.0 stable release (2026-11-03)**

> Author: 永夜廿九 (same name on Bilibili) · Code released under the MIT license · [Download the latest version](https://github.com/Nianjiujiang/pdx-map-editor/releases)

A tool for editing Paradox game maps directly in the browser: fill colors, change colors, rename, and adjust borders, then export as PNG or as a color file.

The editor reads the map data bundled with the game and draws countries, provinces, and place names as an interactive map for the scenario year. Click a tile to change its color, hold and drag to paint a continuous area, right-click to pick a color, and scroll to zoom. It suits making video covers, drawing fictional worlds, illustrating battle reports, or simply viewing the distribution of power in a given year.

No installation or login is required. Once a map pack is imported, it runs entirely locally, so you can keep drawing without a network connection.

## What it can do

- Includes maps from five games: CK3, EU4, HOI4, VIC3, and EU5, showing power distribution by scenario year. EU4 covers 12 scenarios from 1444 to 1792.
- Four editing types: painting, filling, eraser, and renaming. Edits are grouped by “color + tag,” so one click can change an entire territory held by the same power.
- Colors can be chosen via HEX, RGB, palette, recently used colors, and ColorBrewer color scales. Supports 24 favorite colors.
- Borders are layered by level, with five adjustable intensity settings. Water and wasteland each have independent toggles that don’t affect each other.
- Map legends are drawn directly on the map and can be dragged, zoomed, and re-laid out. Exported output matches the on-screen preview.
- Export the current window, the whole map, or a selected region as PNG at 0.1× to 8× scale. Paint work can be saved as JSON or stored in the browser’s map repository.

The screenshots above show the editor’s actual interface; colors and names are rendered live.

## Quick start

There are two ways to use it; choose either one.

| Method | Suited for | How to |
|---|---|---|
| Single file | Just want to use it | Download `pdx-map-editor.html` and double-click to open it in a browser |
| Local service | Modifying code, building yourself | Run `python server.py` in the project directory, then open `http://127.0.0.1:8777/` |

The single-file version does not embed the map. On first open, click “⤓ Download map pack” on the map selection page, or drag a `.pdxmap` file into the window. Phones and tablets use `pdx-map-editor-mobile.html` from the same Release.

When running from source, do not double-click `web/index.html` directly. Under the `file://` protocol, the browser cannot read the map’s binary chunks, so the page will not load properly. `python server.py` starts a local static server and opens the browser automatically. The port can be set with `--port`, and `--no-open` turns off automatic opening.

## Map packs

Map data is released separately from the editor. The repository does not contain `.pdxmap` files; packs are provided as Release attachments and downloaded as needed.

Trojankill/Safe-server-lists-for-bypassi.body:
# 🛡️ VPN Config Security Filter

---

## 🚀 What's new in v6.0

The main change: **every link is now actually parsed**, rather than checked with regexes against the raw string. Percent-encoding is decoded, `&` and `\u0026` are repaired, and parameter synonyms are reduced to a single name. Everything that previously passed as "unreadable — therefore fine" is now rejected.

### 🔬 Parsing and normalization

- ✅ **URI parser instead of regex** — vless / vmess / trojan / hysteria2 / ss / tuic are parsed into a structure
- ✅ **Double decoding** — `&amp;`, `\u0026`, `%5Cu0026`, `¬`
- ✅ **Invisible characters** — zero-width, BOM, `\n`, control chars are stripped before checking
- ✅ **Parameter synonyms** — `allowlnsecure` (with lowercase L), `skip-cert-verify`, `skip_cert_verify`, `insecure`
- ✅ **Lowercase scheme** — `VLESS://` no longer breaks parsing
- ✅ **Insecurity flags** — any value other than an explicit `0/false/no/off` is treated as enabled
- ✅ **vmess `"tls":"none"`** — no longer passes as valid TLS
- ✅ **Duplicates before limits** — one node with different names doesn't crowd out legitimate configs

### 🌐 Addresses and protocols

- ✅ **`ipaddress` instead of regex** — 169.254/16, 100.64/10, 198.18/15,…

chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.description: Daily analysis of Jingcai football matches, interpretation of football betting odds; sports lottery
chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.body:
# ⚽ Football Signal Radar · Daily Signal Report

> **Set emotion aside, watch only the signals.**
> Cross-validation of line movements across three channels; no bets on low odds, no entry when signals are unclear; execution is automatic before the match, settlement is automatic after.

## 🚀 Online Site

- **[https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/](https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/)**
- Updated automatically every hour, historical dates archived, available for review at any time
- Covers **500–1300+** matches per day (Jingcai/Asian handicap, full coverage), automatically flagging signals and bets

---

## The Detours We Bypassed

We tried **models** — piled up parameters until the room was full. Looking back, the model merely recited prices the market had already set; no matter how many parameters, it produced nothing new.

We tried **studying market manipulation** — guessing at the bookmaker's moves, and the more we guessed, the more it resembled paranoid delusion. In the end we realized: guessing the house is worse than reading the price.

We also tried **AI prediction** — injuries, motivation, form; each point was argued eloquently, and each had already been priced into the odds. However lively the argument, the line doesn't accept it.

After the detours, one plain principle remained:

> **Where the money flows, the line speaks.**
> But people watching the line easily get carried away — chasing favorites, fearing underdogs, hands shaking at the last minute; it's obvious at a glance that emotion is doing the trading.

So we hand both "watching" and "buying" to machines, and keep just one thing for people: **discipline**.

## Three Informants, One Referee

**European odds** track market-wide odds movements — which sides are being collectively abandoned, which are quietly being defended, and whether the draw line has been given up. This is the closest informant.

**Asian handicap** tracks lines and water levels — sudden last-minute pivots, snipes by money on the favored side; real money is slammed in, more solid than anything said out loud.

**Over/under** tracks the total line — once a breeding ground for goals appears, the match's goal count is often already known.

Each of the three informants has its own information; only when the information lines up does the referee dare to make the call. **Matches that don't line up (European odds and Asian handicap contradicting each other) are skipped entirely** — when the informants are arguing among themselves, why would you bet at all.

## Discipline Matters More Than Vision

Once the direction is set, everything else is discipline:

- **No bets on low odds** — single-selection odds below 1.5, or double-selection odds below 1.3 after adjustment; no matter how good the signal, it isn't bought. At odds that low, even a win earns nothing.
- **No entry without clear signals** — no signal, conflicting signals, or ambiguous direction means waiting on the sidelines across the board. Missing out doesn't lose money; buying wrong does.
- **Quality determines stake size** — the stronger the signal, the larger the stake (1/2/4 units); no all-in gambling.
- **Bets placed automatically 15 minutes before kickoff, settlement automatic when results come in** — no last-minute shaky hands, no urge to raise stakes after winning or chase losses after losing.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is for data research only and does not constitute any purchase advice. Buy lottery tickets at licensed physical retail outlets; persons under 18 years of age may not participate.

hZsFN/jlu-drcom-ng.description: Jilin University campus network Dr.COM authentication client (Python + Flet, HUD interface): self-healing on port conflicts, plain-language error codes, bundled dependencies for offline packaging
hZsFN/jlu-drcom-ng.body:
# JLU DrCOM NG

Jilin University campus network authentication client, rewritten in Python. The interface is a **HUD (heads-up display) style** panel built on Flet.

It does the same job as the original Qt client: challenge, login, keepalive. But the interface is clearer, failures explain their cause, and when the port is occupied it finds its own way around.

> **Dart edition archived**: `drcom_dart/` + `desktop/` (the Dart authentication core and Flutter desktop client) are the output of last year's rewrite. They take 10 MB and don't require Python, but have fewer features than the Python edition (no headless CLI, no local HTTP status interface, no traffic statistics, no high-contrast/reduced-motion options). **Its installer is no longer published.** The code stays in place and can be consulted at any time, with its state fixed at [tag `dart-2.0.0-archive`](https://github.com/hZsFN/jlu-drcom-ng/tree/dart-2.0.0-archive). For daily use, install the Python edition below.
>
> English documentation: [README_EN.md](https://github.com/hZsFN/jlu-drcom-ng/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md)
>
> **Android edition**: the port that moves the same authentication core onto phones is at [jlu-drcom-android](https://github.com/hZsFN/jlu-drcom-android). The protocol, state machine, and packet construction are reused verbatim. Only three platform modules are swapped out: NIC enumeration, port binding, and password storage. The host becomes Kotlin + Compose, and the Python core is packaged into the APK with Chaquopy.

| Offline | Online |
|---|---|
|  |  |

---

## What it does

**Completes authentication.** The full Dr.COM flow (challenge → login → keepalive1 → keepalive2) runs in rounds every 20 seconds. It reconnects automatically after a drop, using exponential backoff instead of retrying frantically and flooding the server.

**Explains failures clearly.** Every login error code is mapped to plain language plus a line on what to do next. It shows "wrong password" instead of "error code 0x03", and "MAC not bound, you may need to unbind it at the self-service portal first" instead of "error code 0x0B".

**Resolves port conflicts.** The client must bind UDP 61440, a port that is often occupied. A bare `bind failed. Error code: 10013` is nearly useless, because on Windows **10013 has two entirely different causes** that the error code alone cannot distinguish: either the port falls inside a system reserved range (which TUN/VPN software often claims), or …

# Gothic AI

**Gothic II: Night of the Raven, where the residents hear you, answer in their own voices, do what they agreed to, and remember. And you can also lie to them, and the lie works until it is exposed.**

This is the original game on the [OpenGothic](https://github.com/Try/OpenGothic) engine with our changes. Language models stand behind the characters. You hold a key and speak, and the one you addressed hears you, answers aloud, acts, and remembers the conversation in your save. Over the course of the game the director writes new quests. Combat and physics have been reworked, and the world is gradually being remade.

[Site and development diary](https://kaifaty.github.io/GothicAI/) — in Russian and English.

> **Status: early experiment.** The project runs from source on macOS. The Windows build is produced by GitHub, but it has not yet been verified on a real computer. You need your own copy of the Russian Gothic II Gold (with Night of the Raven).

**Dialogue from the game:**

liujiaao/es-plus.body:
# ES-Plus Make AI-generated CRUD pages **directly mergeable into codebases**: the LLM writes a single JSON config, and ES-Plus handles Schema validation and deterministic compilation to produce **Vue 3 + Element Plus / Vue 2 + Element UI / Vue 3 + Ant Design Vue** runnable code, three sets from one pass. Same config, consistent across all three targets, reproducible. Chinese | [English](https://github.com/liujiaao/es-plus/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) The first is the **gate criterion**: in-schema intent hit rate = “zero edits **∨** converged within 3 rounds.” A model that produces a config mergeable with zero edits on the first round, **or** converges to the same config within at most 3 rounds of natural-language correction, counts as a hit ([definition](https://github.com/liujiaao/es-plus/blob/HEAD/docs/internal/wave-2-production-trust-design.md)).
The second is the stricter half: it **counts only first-round zero-edit** results, with no convergence allowance. It is used to distinguish “right the first time” from “right only after several rounds of fixes.”
The corpus currently has 216 examples (194 held out). It is a regression sentinel, not a statistically significant benchmark. Improvement comes from expanding the corpus, not from changing the criteria. The gate target is ≥95%; current measured results are those shown in the badge above (generated by the nightly eval from `__tests__/golden/last-accuracy.json`). **[Online docs](https://liujiaao.github.io/es-plus/)** · **[Playground](https://liujiaao.github.io/es-plus/#/playground)** · **[AI CRUD Generator](https://liujiaao.github.io/es-plus/#/ai-crud)** · **[Changelog](https://github.com/liujiaao/es-plus/releases)** · **[v1.4 Migration Guide](https://github.com/liujiaao/es-plus/blob/HEAD/docs/migrate-v1.4.md)** **Three rendering targets for the same config, each with its own live site**: [Vue 3 + Element Plus](https://liujiaao.github.io/es-plus/) · [Vue 3 + Ant Design Vue](https://liujiaao.github.io/es-plus/es-pc/) · [Vue 2 + Element…

# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

## Features

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.
- **Earnings records**: today, cumulative, paid, pending payment, frozen, and minimum payment amounts; also shows USD valuations with source and timestamp.
- **Training history**: view training tokens, throughput, and cumulative tokens by day, week, or month; missing data is left as gaps.
- **Network visualization**: regional distribution donut chart, miner count rankings, slot occupancy, task progress, and tier overview.

# mackerel-plugin-postfix-log

A plugin that parses Postfix's `maillog` and posts mail delivery delays and forwarding results to Mackerel.

## Overview

This plugin parses Postfix SMTP send logs (`postfix/smtp`) and outputs the following information as Mackerel custom metrics.

- Delivery delay times (total / recving / queuing / connection / transmission)
- Counts by forwarding result (2xx / 4xx / 5xx)
- Ratios by forwarding result (2xx / 4xx / 5xx)

## Installation

### When using the mkr command

Install the Mackerel plugin.

```bash
mkr plugin install monitoring-forge/mackerel-plugin-postfix-log
```

Example install location: `/opt/mackerel-agent/plugins/bin/mackerel-plugin-postfix-log`

### When downloading from GitHub Releases

Download the latest binary for your OS and architecture from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/monitoring-forge/mackerel-plugin-postfix-log/releases/).

```bash
# Example: for Linux x86_64
curl -L -o mackerel-plugin-postfix-log.tar.gz \
  "https://github.com/monitoring-forge/mackerel-plugin-postfix-log/releases/latest/download/mackerel-plugin-postfix-log_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
tar xzf mackerel-plugin-postfix-log.tar.gz
```

## Configuration in mackerel-agent

Add the plugin configuration to `mackerel-agent.conf`.

```ini
[plugin.metrics.postfix_log]
command = ["/opt/mackerel-agent/plugins/bin/mackerel-plugin-postfix-log", "--logfile", "/var/log/maillog"]
```

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-xiaomi-tts@latest
```

# Tianxi Database · Tianxi Database

> Model documentation: [MODEL.md](https://github.com/sleepingarhat/tianxi-racing/blob/HEAD/MODEL.md) (features, training) · [ELO.md](https://github.com/sleepingarhat/tianxi-racing/blob/HEAD/ELO.md) (Elo formula) · Web version https://tianxi.racing/model

> **Hong Kong Horse Racing AI Data Platform**: full historical race results for 2016–2026, daily automatic scraping, Elo rating pipeline, and Data Integrity Audit. It uses GitHub as the backend and CSV as the interface, so downstream users can use it immediately.

**Live data volume (sole source: actual figures from the production D1 database, automatically recalculated daily at 06:00 HKT)** · [JSON](https://tianxi.racing/api/public/data-stats)

---

## Current Products and Operating Basis (2026-10-24)

The first 200 founding members get 52 weeks of Pro (HK$4,056) starting from the gate opening date. The 200-member threshold does not open the gate automatically; payment is collected only after payment verification and the user's explicit approval. Stripe: HK$78/week with automatic renewal. Crypto: US$416, billed once for 52 weeks, displayed as HK$3,244.80 (20% off), with no automatic renewal. Payments are not currently being collected, Crypto and race-day alerts are not enabled, and the payment environment remains live. Favorite horse limits are 30/3/90, and favorite-horse notifications do not add a gate-opening check.

The official site https://tianxi.racing has been published. Platform verification schedule: weather-archive-managed every 5 minutes, weather-sync-github-managed daily at 23:50 HKT, and race-results-dispatch-managed daily at 23:31 and 01:31 HKT. First runs all returned 200; the two weather runs were skipped for safety; the results dispatch was accepted, but that does not mean all results have been collected. After the normal first runs, the old weather-archive-5min, weather-sync-github-nightly, and race-results-dispatch jobs were stopped. Per-race collection is retained. On the first run of each day, once official race completion is verified, the main collection runs 30 minutes later; the fixed late-night run is only a fallback.

Official changes made before lock recalculate only the affected races. After lock, no replacements are made and the original four picks are kept; withdrawals and unfinished races are invalid on a per-horse basis, and the hit-rate denominator is fixed at 4. Withdrawals before lock that have not yet been recalculated also follow the original four picks and the denominator of 4. Actual jockey changes are recorded separately and do not recalculate the original frozen picks. Official pool substitutions and refunds apply only to settling the original bet and cannot change the model's four picks.
